review_description: We were looking to add a battery and heat pump HWS to our 8 kW solar system which was installed 5 years ago.Having an on-site visit to discuss options was a big plus, and the installation was very professional - efficient, neat work and friendly team. The communication from Bluegum was also excellent with notifications of when the team were on their way.Nice to be able to support a local company.

Really took the time to go through options and give us a good breakdown on why they recommended what they did. They were great in making sure the system would work for us and kept us informed during the installation process.

Had a really good experience with Chantel and Josh. Both were super friendly, helpful. Explained things in a way I'd understand and never tried to upsell me. Ended up settling with a Tesla battery. Waiting on install. So far so good.

Josh Gilbert, owner of Bluegum and electrician (not just a sales person) and in due course was hands-on involved in the installation, came to do the consultation/system design and made a very positive impression.  He was obviously very knowledgeable, experienced, considerate of our needs, including being able to arrange or carry out important ancillary works such as a new reverse cycle air-con/heating system, heat pump hot water system and other minor electrical works.  I bought on expectations of superior and hands-on quality of service at all stages (as opposed to price alone) and have not been disappointed.  Josh's install team were excellent.  Prompt, considerate, cleaned up completely; great in all respects.  The office team, under Josh's wife Chantel (and co-owner) were able to answer questions, arrange the scheduling and provide efficient service.  All in all, I chose Bluegum because I believed I could detect a greater "care factor" that would derive from a hands-on approach from the business owners.  I thought they would be a 'cut above' the other two firms that quoted and I believe that I have got this superior level of service.  Highly recommended.
Bluegum Solar was very proactive in their approach and gave us the confidence and comfort to go with them in our Solar investment
